description: This file implements the MediaKeySession class and related factory functions for managing media key sessions, including creation, request generation, challenge handling, decryption, and session management within a DRM context.

classes.name: IMediaKeySessionFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating media key sessions.

classes.name: MediaKeySession
classes.description: Implements media key session management, including license handling, decryption, and session lifecycle.

methods.name: IMediaKeySessionFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory instance for media key sessions.

methods.name: MediaKeySessionFactory::createMediaKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new media key session with specified parameters.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::MediaKeySession
methods.description: Constructor initializing a media key session object.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::~MediaKeySession
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up session resources.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request based on init data.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::getChallenge
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data for license acquisition.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::loadSession
methods.description: Loads an existing session.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::updateSession
methods.description: Updates the session with license response data.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts encrypted media buffers.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::closeKeySession
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the key session.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::removeKeySession
methods.description: Removes the key session.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key ID is present in the session.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets the DRM header for the session.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for the session.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::onProcessChallenge
methods.description: Handles processing of license challenge data.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::onKeyUpdated
methods.description: Handles updates to keys.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::onAllKeysUpdated
methods.description: Handles notification that all keys are updated.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::onError
methods.description: Handles error callbacks from OCDM.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::initOcdmErrorChecking
methods.description: Initializes error checking for OCDM operations.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::checkForOcdmErrors
methods.description: Checks for errors reported during OCDM operations.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Determines if the key system is PlayReady.
